extracted.intended_audience: research mathematicians in arithmetic geometry/number theory familiar with Mochizuki's IUT framework
extracted.subtask_description: Algorithms and structural requirements for constructing constant/theta/gaussian monoids, Kummer/poly-isomorphisms, and associated (pre-)Frobenioids in the IUT/Hodge-theatre setting, with required compatibilities and localisation data. The material specifies how local constructions globalise, how symmetrisations and splittings behave, and what indeterminacies are allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Functorial construction of constant monoids
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a functorial algorithm, with respect to a given prime-strip (D- or F-prime-strip), to assign for each place v a constant/ind-topological monoid (cid:9)cns(zD)v (resp. (cid:9)cns(zF)v).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The assignment must be functorial in the prime-strip variable, produce (ind-)topological monoids equipped with the relevant Gv-actions, and the resulting (cid:9)cns(zD)v is well-defined only up to conjugacy indeterminacy for v in Vnon. Use the local constructions (v in Vbad, Vgood, Varc) as input to the global algorithm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mono-analytic semi-simplifications (ss_cns) with splittings
rubrics_metrics.description: Construct mono-analytic semi-simplified monoids (cid:9)ss_cns(zD' )v (resp. (cid:9)ss_cns(zF' )v) for each v, each equipped with a natural splitting and R0-module structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These assignments must be functorial with respect to the D'- or F'-prime-strip, be compatible with the natural splittings (written as (cid:9)ss_cns(...)(cid:2) R0(...)), and be well-defined up to conjugacy indeterminacy at v in Vnon. For Varc places, additional structures (e.g., distinguished elements) may appear; relate these to local data via localisation isomorphisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Existence and uniqueness of Kummer isomorphisms
rubrics_metrics.description: There must exist unique Kummer isomorphisms Kum ! (cid:9)cns(...) (and converses) between the constructed monoids and model Kummer-type monoids.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Kummer isomorphisms should be isomorphisms of (ind-)topological monoids compatible with the relevant Gv-actions, send distinguished generators appropriately, and be used to identify local constructions with global model objects (they may be unique up to inner automorphism as specified).

rubrics_metrics.name: Conjugate synchronisation / Fo-symmetrising isomorphisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Construct symmetrising (conjugate synchronisation) isomorphisms between labelled data indexed by cusps/labels (LabCusp), induced by local Fo-actions, that determine diagonal submonoids and identify labelled collections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These Fo-symmetrising isomorphisms must be compatible with the (doubly-transitive) Fo-action on the index set, determine diagonal submonoids (products indexed over label-sets) and produce diagonal-to-labelled isomorphisms diag ! hF>l; they may be well-defined only up to an inner automorphism independent of the label index.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theta (env) and Gaussian (gau) monoid constructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Define theta monoids env(...) and Gaussian monoids gau(...) (local and global versions) equipped with natural Gv-actions and natural splittings, together with formal evaluation isomorphisms env eval! gau.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The constructions must be functorial in the prime-strip or Hodge-theatre data, give monoids with splittings and R0-structures, and produce evaluation isomorphisms that restrict to identity on the respective canonical copies and are compatible with Gv-actions and natural splittings. There should be both local (per-v) and global realiﬁed versions, glued compatibly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal evaluation isomorphism compatibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The formal evaluation map env(eval)!gau (and its global analogue) must exist and be compatible with local evaluation isomorphisms, localisation maps, and bijections Prime() ! V.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation isomorphisms should restrict to identity (or the appropriate inverse/isomorphism of the Kummer map) on canonical copies, respect Gv-actions and splittings, and glue across localisations to a global eval isomorphism of (pre-)Frobenioids.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uniradial / multiradial nature of constructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify whether each construction is uniradial or multiradial: e.g., cns(...) constructions are uniradial, env/gau and ss constructions are multiradial.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document the radiality property (uniradial vs multiradial) as it affects how the construction depends on choices and how it globalises; this is used to justify the functorial/gluing procedures and the use of holomorphic vs mono-analytic structures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Well-definedness up to conjugacy / inner automorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: Many assigned objects (cns, ss_cns, identifications) are only well-defined up to conjugacy by elements (e.g., z(cid:5)v-conjugacy or y(cid:5)v inner automorphisms) at non-regular places.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record where conjugacy indeterminacies occur (typically v in Vnon) and ensure constructions either mod out by or otherwise control these indeterminacies; where needed, work with prime-strips or Galois-invariant pieces to avoid conjugacy problems (as in F>-symmetry remarks).

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural splittings and distinguished logarithmic element
rubrics_metrics.description: Each split semi-simple monoid R0(...)v should come with a distinguished element (e.g., z'_D log(pv) in R0(zD')v) whose natural logarithm is specified (often equal to 1 in normalization).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure R0-modules and splittings are specified and the distinguished element is exhibited; note that in some constructions this distinguished element may not be invariant under automorphisms of the ambient object and must be tracked carefully.

rubrics_metrics.name: Localisation isomorphisms to R0/topological monoids
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide localisation isomorphisms ('gl: to loc:') mapping global realiﬁed Frobenioid objects to local R0 topological monoids or to the constructed local env/gau objects for each v with Prime bijections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Localisation maps must be functorial, compatible with the bijection Prime() ! V, respect topological monoid structure, and be compatible with other isomorphisms (Kummer, evaluation). They are essential for gluing local data to global objects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global realiﬁed (pre-)Frobenioid construction with Prime bijection
rubrics_metrics.description: Construct a global realiﬁed (pre-)Frobenioid D(...)(...) (or C(...) etc.) equipped with a bijection Prime(...) ! V and localisation isomorphisms to local env/gau objects, determined functorially from prime-strip data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The global object must be assembled by the functorial algorithm from local data, respect the Prime <-> V bijection, and admit localisation isomorphisms gl: to loc: for each v that recover the local topological monoids and are compatible with evaluation and Kummer isomorphisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compatibility of local and global evaluation and localisation maps
rubrics_metrics.description: All local evaluation isomorphisms and localisation isomorphisms must be compatible with the global evaluation isomorphism and with each other under the identifications Prime() ! V.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This compatibility is required for the global eval: env -> gau to be well-defined and for the construction of global Frobenioids; check compatibility at each v and for each gl: to loc: map.

rubrics_metrics.name: NF-counterpart / non-realiﬁed constructions and conversions
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide NF (non-realiﬁed) analogues to Hodge-Arakelov-theoretic evaluation permitting conversion between (cid:2)-line bundles and (cid:1)-line bundles via actions on mono-analytic log-shells.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This NF-counterpart must be constructed functorially and integrated into the final multiradial algorithm, enabling conversions (via category equivalence 'Convert') between different types of line bundles used in the global construction (see Proposition 13.11, Corollary 13.13 references).

rubrics_metrics.name: F>_l-symmetry constructions and restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: When working with F>_l symmetry (a subquotient of Gal(K/F)), construct F-prime-strips and F>_l-symmetrising isomorphisms acting on labelled data, but avoid conjugate synchronisations that require full Galois conjugation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because F>_l acts nontrivially on number fields, perform constructions on F-prime-strips and label-with-mod/1(...) objects where Galois action is trivial or conjugacy indeterminacy can be ignored; record which objects one must use (F-prime-strips, mod-labelled objects, 1-labelled objects).

rubrics_metrics.name: Poly-isomorphisms as analogues of Kummer isomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: Produce collections of poly-isomorphisms (denoted \Kum" poly) relating ss_cns of F- and D-type objects, serving as analogues of Kummer isomorphisms across different realiﬁcations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These poly-isomorphisms must be functorial in the associated prime-strip, compatible with localisation data, and used to compute distinguished elements at archimedean places from non-archimedean data when reconstructing global structures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gluing across bridges/Hodge theatres and passage to F (cid:13)-prime-strips
rubrics_metrics.description: Glue local and (cid:2)/(cid:1)-level constructions across bridges to produce F (cid:13)-prime-strips such as yF(cid:13), yF(cid:13)_env, yF(cid:13)_gau, with associated localisation and evaluation data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The gluing must respect identifications provided by Lemma 10.38 and related algorithms; check that resulting prime-strips inherit Prime -> V bijections, localisation maps and are compatible with evaluation isomorphisms produced locally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguished elements may not be Galois-invariant
rubrics_metrics.description: Note that distinguished elements in (cid:9)ss_yF'v are not necessarily preserved by automorphisms of yF'v, and their computation at archimedean places may depend on global structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track invariance properties: where distinguished elements are not Galois-invariant, use the global realiﬁed Frobenioid structure and rational function monoids to compute/identify them; be cautious when transporting such elements under isomorphisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation isomorphisms restrict to identity/inverse on canonical copies
rubrics_metrics.description: The formal/local evaluation isomorphisms must restrict to the identity (or the inverse of the Kummer isomorphism) on the specified canonical copies of the base monoids (cid:9)cns(...) (cid:2) etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify restriction behaviour explicitly in each local/global eval construction to ensure coherence of identifications and that splittings and Gv-actions agree on those canonical subcopies.
